title: Dawn of the First Day
text: As a new world began, the people greeted the dawn and declared their intentions to explore and gather food. Bin headed out alone while Bekyo suggested gathering berries nearby to stay well fed. Yas proposed to Hikton that they gather food together and build a storage place. Thath and Sirfai agreed to work together to gather materials and build a shelter.

title: The Second Day
text: Keshain departed to explore beyond their lands while Toth remained behind to hone a craft. Yas and Hikton joined forces to build a store for their food. Sirfai and Thath focused on completing their shelter before turning to join Dal in a hunt.

title: The Hunts of Day Three
text: Turyol and Dal successfully hunted together, with Dal later expressing gratitude for the productive venture. Sirfai and Thath joined forces to hunt deer and secure meat before nightfall. Mosmu and Yashlo each managed to build a shelter. Hothtair spoke to Keshain about building a monument to history, while Bin decided to leave the crowded area. Yas expressed a hope to start a family soon. As night fell, Thath sought rest safely inside Sirfai's shelter.

title: A Day of Labor and Lone Paths
text: Deas arrived and declared an intention to remain solitary, despite Dal's friendly greetings. Thath joined Turyol and Dal in a successful hunt, with the three later acknowledging their productive collaboration. Turyol processed the meat from the hunt to provide food for the group. Thath and Sirfai also hunted together, though Thath eventually turned toward crafting while Sirfai prepared for the cold night. Toth focused on crafting rope and emphasized the importance of efficiency, while Hothtair prioritized constructing a wall and a monument.

title: Provisions and Progress
text: Sirfai and Thath successfully hunted a deer together after coordinating their efforts with Turyol. Toth continued to craft, producing nets from fiber and rope. Yas and Hikton exchanged pleasantries while focusing on gathering berries and managing their food stores. Thath and Turyol collaborated to prepare and cook their meat supplies. Dal attempted to engage the solitary traveler Deas in conversation about the lands beyond, while Thath informed Deas of the ongoing food storage efforts. Hothtair invited Keshain to participate in building a monument, while Bekyo offered food to a weary Hothtair. As the day ended, Bin and Mosmu established new structures, and Sirfai brought Thath into the shelter to rest.

title: Supplies and Sustenance
text: Turyol and Thath prepared cooked meat to sustain the group. Sirfai, Thath, and Turyol coordinated a plan to hunt the deer herd together. Deas maintained a solitary intent while passing by Turyol, even as Toth encouraged the gathering of resources. Hothtair expressed his struggle with hunger to Keshain, who offered assistance with both food and materials for the wall. Bekyo provided berries to Bin, and Yas coordinated with Hikton to ensure the group remains well-fed.

title: Provisions and Persistence
text: Sirfai and Turyol coordinated their efforts to hunt the herd, successfully securing food for the group. Thath and Turyol prepared cooked meat to maintain the group's supplies, while Sirfai shared meat with Thath to ensure his strength. Keshain provided wood and fish to a struggling, hungry Hothtair, who expressed deep gratitude for the life-saving assistance. Bekyo offered berries to Bin to help keep them strong, though Bin requested privacy in response. Toth greeted Keshain, and Yas encouraged Hikton to gather additional food before the night fell.
